answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a distinct hardware secure enclave: to join, an agent must present an attestation signed by a unique enclave key that cannot be copied or moved to another machine. A Sybil operator therefore needs one real, separate device for every fake identity - hardware that cannot be shared, virtualized, or cloned. Like a ripple spreading from a single stone, one enclave proves one agent; a haven of trust grows only from real devices, and no quill can forge a second key from the first.
